Bombay High Court Orders CBI Probe into Disha Salian Death

The Bombay High Court has ordered the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) to take over the investigation into the death of Disha Salian, the former manager of actor Sushant Singh Rajput. The court directed the CBI to register a First Information Report (FIR) and conduct a fresh probe into the case. The High Court's decision came after it questioned the investigation conducted by the Mumbai Police, noting that the case had been pending for a long time without significant progress. The father of Disha Salian, Satish Salian, expressed relief and emotional response to the court's order.
